questions.prompt: Give TWO differences between Thomson's plum-pudding model and Rutherford's nuclear model.

accepted: Thomson described positive charge spread throughout the atom; Rutherford located it in a small central nucleus. Thomson's model did not recognise the atom as mostly empty space; Rutherford's model did.
